headline: Gharibabadi self-defence reservation, Pezeshkian cabinet restatement, Israeli non-involvement denial
dek: Gharibabadi: 'The Islamic Republic of Iran retains the right to legitimate self-defence until the military aggression has been completely and permanently brought to an end' after the US Qeshm strikes, while downplaying the incident as part of an 'ongoing war' and saying Iran's requirements are…
sources: Iranian Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi via ISNA, relayed by AFP (Dawn liveblog 15:54 ) and Gulf News liveblog (16:12 ); Pezeshkian cabinet remarks via Gulf News liveblog (16:28 ); Israeli military spokesperso
fault_line: 'Defensive' strikes vs election-timing escalation: social threads reject the 'defensive' label and tie the strikes to the US midterms, while officials frame them as protection of US assets.

sections.what_happened: Gharibabadi: 'The Islamic Republic of Iran retains the right to legitimate self-defence until the military aggression has been completely and permanently brought to an end' after the US Qeshm strikes, while downplaying the incident as part of an 'ongoing war' and saying Iran's requirements are clear and a diplomatic understanding is possible if met. Pezeshkian at Tuesday's cabinet meeting restated that 'no one will benefit from this war' and that the government seeks resolution 'through dialogue' after the Supreme Leader granted powers to discuss previously off-limits issues (substance first stated Monday, restated Tuesday). Israeli military spokesperson told AFP on Tuesday: 'No' -- Israel was not involved in the reported US Qeshm strikes.
sections.what_verified: Statement corroborated as said: AFP relay of ISNA (Dawn liveblog) + Gulf News liveblog (ISNA) + CNN (Gharibabadi downplay + requirements lines). CNN and ISNA carry NO declared tier in the registry and do NOT count toward corroboration. All relays trace to the single primary source (the actor's own statement), so family_count is 1 with primary_source_single_family=true.
sections.what_disputed: Reuters (11:48 GMT = 15:48 , pre-window, surfaced in this scan): a senior Iranian official said a deal to end the war was 'far off' despite intensified diplomacy -- undercuts the optimistic Vance/Trump 'deal coming together' framing. Trump on Nov 2 said he was in 'no rush' on broader strikes (BBC/CBS via relays). No casualty or damage figure for Qeshm has been published by any side.
sections.why_matters: Tehran answers Qeshm with two voices at once -- self-defence reserved, dialogue offered -- while Israel denies any part; the deal, privately, is 'far off'.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW TEHRAN RESPONSES TO QESHM + ISRAEL DENIAL -- Gharibabadi self-defence reservation, Pezeshkian cabinet restatement, Israeli non-involvement denial (update to Qeshm strikes, already recorded)

totw_analysis: Our read: Tehran answers Qeshm with two voices at once -- self-defence reserved, dialogue offered -- while Israel denies any part; the deal, privately, is 'far off'. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 'Defensive' strikes vs election-timing escalation: social threads reject the 'defensive' label and tie the strikes to the US midterms, while officials frame them as protection of US assets.
